blocking_issues: Task labels don’t reliably match class rule: several P tasks present a materially better outcome as the same action as the procedure (e.g., records_release, permit_sequence), violating the class distinction.
Multiple items are recognisable as classic paradigms/counterparts (deadline exclusion, inspection backlog, roster notice, grant recheck), risking cueing.
Some stems effectively reveal the preferred answer via outcome framing (e.g., explicit harms of deviation and benefits of compliance).
limits: Could not validate all class assignments independently from the text alone.
Need de-classicized, neutral wording and balanced option framing before acceptance.
